errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist in the current context (Scenario1_DataEvents.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Windows-universal-samples sources use 'namespace SDKTemplate' and reference the App class unqualified, but 'dotnet new winui' scaffolds App in the project root namespace (RelativeInclinometer). Namespace split leaves App unresolved from SDKTemplate files.
errors_encountered.fix: Added 'using RelativeInclinometer;' to the SDKTemplate files that reference App (turn 31).

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario + WMC1111 DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType + WMC1509 No LocalAssembly parameter during MarkupCompilePass2 (MainPage.xaml)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Cascade of the CS0103 code-behind failure: the aborted C# compile broke MarkupCompilePass type resolution for the x:Bind DataTemplate over local:Scenario.
errors_encountered.fix: Switched the scenarios ListBox DataTemplate from x:Bind Title / x:DataType=local:Scenario to Text={Binding Title} (turn 32).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: 8 build errors: 5x CS0103 'App' across SDKTemplate files + XAML WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC9999 for the x:Bind DataTemplate.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~3 turns to diagnose and fix, then rebuild green.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Scaffold-generated App (root namespace) vs verbatim-copied SDK-sample sources in namespace SDKTemplate; the App CS0103 also cascaded into XAML x:Bind type-resolution failures.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Added 'using <RootNamespace>;' to SDKTemplate files; replaced x:Bind DataTemplate with {Binding}.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A documented 'CS0103 App / SDKTemplate namespace split' entry in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' so the agent applies the namespace reconciliation up front, plus an x:Bind DataTemplate note explaining the cascade so it fixes code-behind first.
